metadata.title: TAMU Datathon 2026 official challenge catalog
metadata.provenance: Official challenge pages and linked public participant guides read by the assistant; Build-A-Dataset guide reviewed in full by the main assistant.
metadata.note: Official metadata is separate from Discord observations. Prize values and per-person allocation are not inferred.

event_schedule.note: Event times do not override challenge-specific submission deadlines.

general_eligibility.source_note: Verified in the current 2026 homepage's public client bundle because the text-only web extractor omits the interactive FAQ answers.
general_eligibility.admission: Enrolled undergraduate or graduate students at least 18 years old, and people who graduated within one year of the event; all majors and students worldwide welcomed.

challenges.name: Rev's Casino
challenges.objective: Complete increasingly difficult LLM prompt challenges while minimizing tokens.
challenges.scoring: Fewest tokens to beat all levels, according to the public challenge page. Detailed tie-breaking and leaderboard rules were not available without app sign-in.
challenges.submission: Play in the linked app; Google sign-in is required to save progress and tokens.

challenges.name: Dashboard Royale
challenges.objective: Investigate a fictional casino's machine performance, demand, downtime, players, comps and a $100,000 action plan using an interactive dashboard.
submission: Decision-relevant model versus baseline on time holdout
Up to three priced action types
eligibility_constraints: Use fictional-casino claims accurately
Public outside data allowed with citations
AI allowed with disclosure
Follow action-catalog budgets, limits and incompatibilities

prizes.2: Logitech G703 Lightspeed Wireless Gaming Mouse

unknowns: Challenge deadline: guide delegates to Devpost, which was inaccessible in this research

challenges.name: Build-A-Dataset
challenges.objective: Collect original real-world observations during the event and use that dataset to power an interactive app, map, game or tool.
challenges.scoring: Five categories worth 20 points each; 100 total.
submission: GitHub repository with application code, shareable dataset, collection methodology, data dictionary, limitations and run instructions
Approximately two-minute video showing collection, dataset and working app
Submit through event Devpost before its deadline
eligibility_constraints: Team must collect new primary data during the event through physical real-world engagement
Collected data must be central to a functioning interactive application
Scraping, APIs and existing datasets may supplement but cannot replace primary collection
Document collection and processing honestly
Consent and venue-compliant collection; shareable data without identifying or sensitive details
No fabricated observations or misrepresented collection

prizes.3: MSY Voucher + Tray of Mac and Cheese

challenges.current_project_fit: Discord-only observations do not satisfy the guide requirement for new primary data collected through physical real-world engagement. This project contains no field survey data.
unknowns: General rule about entering the same project in multiple tracks

challenges.name: House Edge
challenges.objective: Predict five next-payout probabilities from simulated slot-machine histories.
challenges.scoring: Main 80 points plus adaptation 20. Squared probability errors are averaged within episodes and four equally weighted conditions, normalized against frozen reference errors. Round points = round maximum / (1 + mean normalized error).
challenges.submission: Per round: UTF-8 prediction CSV plus code ZIP that reproduces probabilities. Mandatory team registration; latest accepted entry counts, including later reproduction failure.
challenges.deadline: Guide repeatedly states main closes Sunday Nov 8 at 10:30 AM Central and adaptation closes noon.
challenges.schedule_conflict: Public card says adaptation opens Saturday 9 PM. Guide now repeatedly says Sunday 10:30 AM, but retains contradictory Saturday/date, overnight and 14-hour wording. Verify current organizer announcement/submission page.
eligibility_constraints: No individual registered on multiple teams
Organizer-released data only
No hidden test answers
Code reproduction and data-use checks required
No future-tick inputs
Valid main entry required for overall ranking

challenges.name: Heads Up – Poker Bot Tournament
challenges.objective: Build a Python bot for heads-up Short Deck 5-Card Pot-Limit Omaha.
challenges.scoring: Round robin; each match replays 1,000 deals with seats swapped (2,000 hands). A 95% confidence interval above zero earns a win (1), touching zero a draw (0.5), below zero a loss (0). Total points rank teams; mean big blinds per deal breaks ties.
challenges.submission: Public GitHub repository and full pushed 40-character commit SHA. Latest successful build before deadline plays.
eligibility_constraints: Mandatory registration
No person registered on multiple teams
1 CPU, 4 GB RAM, no network
8-second time bank per half, 1-second request limit
Five errors in a half causes match forfeit
Runtime settings may change; updated game.py is source of truth
unknowns: Guide deadline is still a placeholder

challenges.name: Hitachi: Hack the Highway
challenges.objective: Use an LLM coordinator and three specialist agents, a knowledge graph, and enterprise tools to handle simulated automaker operational events.
eligibility_constraints: Teams of 3–4
24 hours stated in brief
No hard-coded answers or hidden files
Operate from event text and supplied tables
Noise requires no writes; unconfirmed reports require escalation
At least three action types per real incident, following handbook

challenges.name: Best Use of Databricks
challenges.objective: Use Databricks creatively for data engineering, analytics, ML or AI, alone or within another Datathon challenge.
challenges.scoring: Creativity, technical implementation and meaningful improvement from Databricks. Numerical weights not supplied.
eligibility_constraints: Databricks must meaningfully improve the solution; standalone and cross-challenge projects allowed
